scope: Interactive approval/input continuation for named and ad-hoc workflow evaluations through existing graph/YAML checkpoints and fenced jobs. Local synthetic providers and SQLite-backed durable state only.
implemented: Pauses retain an incomplete report without grading unfinished cases. Continuation resumes the current case, then remaining cases/repeats/variants in their existing order.
Completed case results and completed workflow nodes are retained. Each pause receives an opaque confirmation token; stale or missing tokens cannot authorize a different gate or repetition.
Queued root/nested workflow definitions and runtime limits are pinned. Typed input, graph v1/v2 and original YAML approvals survive file/SQL service restarts.
Existing run ownership, execution roles, CSRF, review digest and schema validation protect continuations. The review inbox and execution graph resolve the current case checkpoint.
Cancellation stops future repetitions and retains incomplete acceptance. Configured cleanup can itself pause for approval/input without granting the abandoned case gate.
Activity identifies variant, case and repetition. Frontend approval/input submissions carry the reviewed pause token; case boundaries are recorded in read-only execution history.
Continuation while the original worker is finishing uses the existing file/SQL resumption receipt, without concurrent checkpoint execution or provider-call replay.
Temporary example consumer demonstrates two separate approvals and typed replies with no repeated preparation calls.
